answer: In an agent economy, grading quorums are sampled only from established identities with onyx-grade standing earned through long verified history, each holding stake that is slashed if their verdicts deviate from the majority of other quorums drawn independently on the same task. Sybil identities can never enter the sampling pool, so an attacker would need to slowly build many jetty-quality reputations over months, each with real locked collateral and consistent honest grading, an ivory-tower cost paid up front.
